```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ==========================================================
# LOAD EDITABLE CONTENT
# ==========================================================

with open("content/tools.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
section = data.get("section", {})
resources = data.get("resources", [])


# ==========================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================================

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)


def render_resource(resource):
    title = safe(resource.get("title"))
    category = safe(resource.get("category"))
    language = safe(resource.get("language"))
    description = safe(resource.get("description"))
    url = safe(resource.get("url"))
    button = safe(resource.get("button_label", "View Resource"))

    return f"""
    <article class="cw-tool-card">

      <div class="cw-tool-card-top">
        <span class="cw-tool-category">{category}</span>
        <span class="cw-tool-language">{language}</span>
      </div>

      <h3>{title}</h3>

      <p class="cw-tool-description">{description}</p>

      <div class="cw-tool-card-footer">
        <a href="{url}"
           class="cw-tool-button"
           target="_blank"
           rel="noopener noreferrer">
          {button} <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        </a>
      </div>

    </article>
    """


# ==========================================================
# GENERATE RESOURCE CARDS
# ==========================================================

cards = "".join(
    render_resource(resource)
    for resource in resources
)


# ==========================================================
# BUILD PAGE HTML
# ==========================================================

html = f"""
<div class="cw-tools">

  <!-- HERO SECTION -->
  <section class="cw-tools-hero">

    <div class="cw-tools-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-tools-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>
        {safe(hero.get("description"))}
      </p>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- SOFTWARE DIRECTORY -->
  <section class="cw-tools-directory">

    <div class="cw-tools-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-tools-section-label">
        {safe(section.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(section.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>
        {safe(section.get("description"))}
      </p>

    </div>


    <!-- RESOURCE CARDS -->
    <div class="cw-tools-grid" id="toolGrid">
      {cards}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
